proposed_widenings.name: activated_magic_item_ongoing_aura
proposed_widenings.justification: The item combines a passive held grant with a separate activated property that creates a timed persistent aura. Current magic-item activations only express one-shot phase sequences; they do not model an activation that establishes an ongoing area benefit window.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "As a Magic action, you can plant the haft end of the rod in the ground... While in that Bright Light, you and your allies gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class and saving throws... The effect ends after 10 minutes"

proposed_widenings.name: friendly_creature_area_filter
proposed_widenings.justification: Current target and area attachments can select creatures in an area, but they cannot restrict a persistent benefit to the user and allies while excluding other creatures in the same area.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "While in that Bright Light, you and your allies gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class and saving throws"

proposed_widenings.name: activated_item_early_end_on_pull
proposed_widenings.justification: The aura has a deterministic manual dismissal condition tied to another creature using a Magic action on the planted rod. Existing activated-ability duration/reset shapes do not encode this early-end trigger.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "the effect ends after 10 minutes or when a creature takes a Magic action to pull the rod from the ground"

notes: The passive held properties fit existing surface pieces (`holding_item`, `modify_roll_advantage`, `grant_spell_access`), but the activated Protective Aura does not fit honestly enough to author a partial content file without misrepresenting the item.
